violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. There is an unapproved 2-way garden hose splitter installed on the mop sink, which is accommodating the mop sink chemical dispenser.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. The EHS provided the PIC with an example of an approved splitter, a Hydro Systems 1951 Pressure Bleed Dual Valve. If the splitter is needed, it must be this type. Please replace the current splitter with the recommended one. The manager disconnected the unit during the inspection to correct. CDI.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: observed 1 DR multiplex at drink station with gasket that is unable to fully seal the door closed. Observed exposed styrofoam inside unit with significant debris.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Please repair or replace unit.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink by the 3 compartment sink is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. OBSERVED THE HOT WATER AT THE HAND SINK AT 95F
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. EMPLOYEE ADJUSTED THE SINK AND HOT WATER WAS OBSERVED AT 111F
